{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :-
1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC.
2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm.
3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT.
4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field is marked '---' while note N3 specifies case hardening to 56–60 HRC with a case depth of 0.8–1.2 mm but does not state at which manufacturing stage the treatment applies (e.g., after rough machining, before finish grinding). This ambiguity can cause the shop to apply heat treatment at the wrong point in the process, leading to distortion or inability to hold final tolerances. The designer should fill the heat treatment field and add the processing stage to note N3.","recommended_correction":"Update the title block heat treatment field to match note N3 and revise note N3 to specify the manufacturing stage at which case hardening is to be performed."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D14","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 50 H7 +0.025"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D7","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 8 H7"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D23","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 6 H7"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"MATERIAL: 20mNcR5
FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)
MACHINING:
WEIGHT(Kg ): 2.15 kg"}],"comment":"Dimensions D14 (⌀ 50 H7), D7 (⌀ 8 H7), and D23 (⌀ 6 H7) carry ISO fit callouts on a part that note N4 requires to be plated (I.Z.B.P. trivalent zinc plating), yet no allowance for plating thickness is indicated on these tight-fit features. Plating buildup will reduce hole diameters and may prevent mating parts from assembling. The designer should either specify pre-plate undersize limits for these holes or add a note requiring reaming/broaching after plating.","recommended_correction":"Add plating-thickness allowances or post-plating machining instructions for the H7 holes called out by D14, D7, and D23."}]}
